**Access boundary:** Restricted operator authority required.

API 1.1.22 and migrations 0068–0070 were deployed on 31 October; the legacy native extension and triggered/resolved email receipt were observed without establishing business recovery. The query/Manual-mode stabilization is a separate local candidate, not applied or receipt-qualified. Genuine Pingen/Resend renewal, independent source access and real delivery retain separate qualification.

**Surfaces:** Existing private scheduled maintenance, provider-inspection RPC/operator CLI, GitHub scanner watchdog and separately authorized native-monitor configuration; no public browser, REST or MCP maintenance surface.

[Read the engineering guide](/engineering/provider-maintenance/) · [All features](/features/)
